profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building enterprise software and AI-powered products, currently focused on production AI experiences across Power Platform and Microsoft Copilot. My work sits at the intersection of AI product development, platform engineering, telemetry and observability, Responsible AI, and compliance.

Over the past several years, I have driven the technical delivery of AI-powered features from concept to public release, including telemetry strategy, experimentation, quality evaluation, Responsible AI assessments, harms testing, compliance readiness, and post-launch monitoring. I enjoy building the systems and platform capabilities that make AI features measurable, reliable, safe, and scalable in production.
